title: Enforce separation of ICT change roles
objective: No person can approve an ICT change that the same person requested or implemented.
trigger_or_frequency: Before approval of every production ICT change

implementation_rules.statement: The workflow compares requester, implementer, and approver identities and rejects an approval when the approver matches either conflicting role.
implementation_rules.failure_handling: Block the approval and notify the change management owner.
